name: The Lamb household at 2011 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_lamb_augustus_d

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 2011 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 2011 Augustus D. Lamb; Benjamin B. Lamb.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2011, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. A house of this kind kept live-in staff, and the 1900 and 1910 censuses name them; neither was read for this card, so no staff are listed. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Augustus D. Lamb
persons.note: Listed first of the two Lambs at 2011; the Blue Book does not say who headed the house, and the card is anchored on the first name.

persons.name: Benjamin B. Lamb
persons.note: Listed at 2011 in both editions. The Blue Book does not say how the two Lambs were related.
